description: On the blue-covered bed in front of a pink pillow, there’s a small stack of bowls with an orange bowl nested on top of a light blue bowl. The right hand reaches in from the lower right, grips the orange bowl, lifts it up and to the left, then sets it down in the middle; next the right hand grasps the remaining blue bowl stack on the right, lifts one blue bowl out, and places it down closer to the front, leaving two blue bowls separated.
